Romualdez, Agusan del Norte|Remedios T. Romualdez]] | [[Santiago, Agusan del Norte|Santiago]] | [[Tubay]] }} | year = 1967 | members_label = Representative | members = [[Dale Corvera]] | blank1_name = Political party | blank1_info = {{Color box|{{party color|Partido Federal ng Pilipinas}}|border=darkgray}} [[Partido Federal ng Pilipinas|PFP]] | blank2_name = Congressional bloc | blank2_info = Majority }} '''Agusan del Norte's at-large congressional district''' is a [[congressional districts of the Philippines|congressional district]] in the province of [[Agusan del Norte]] in the Philippines. It has been represented in the House of Representatives of the Philippines since 1969. It encompasses the city of [[Cabadbaran]], the provincial capital, and all municipalities of Agusan del Norte. It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Dale Corvera]] of the [[Lakas–CMD]]. It was created in 1967 as a result of the creation of province of Agusan del Norte out of [[Agusan (province)|Agusan]] province, where Agusan del Norte encompasses the northern part of the area. It was declared an official district in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|House of Representatives]] from 1969 to 1972 and in the [[Regular Batasang Pambansa]] from 1984 to 1986.{{cite web |url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 25, 2021 |archive-date=March 16, 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170316064243/http://congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |url-status=dead }} The district elected its first representative province-wide [[at-large]] during the [[1969 Philippine House of Representatives elections]].{{cite web|url=https://www.officialgazette.gov.ph/1967/06/17/republic-act-no-4979/ |title=Republic Act No. 4979 |date=June 17, 1967 |publisher=[[Official Gazette (Philippines)]] |accessdate=February 25, 2021}} However, the representative system was eliminated following the dissolution of the lower house in 1972. This was later absorbed by the multi-member [[Northern Mindanao's at-large parliamentary district|Region X's district]] for the [[Interim Batasang Pambansa|national parliament]] in 1978. In 1984, provincial and city representations were restored and Agusan del Norte elected a member for the regular parliament.{{cite web|url=https://lawyerly.ph/laws/view/l829a |title=Batas Pambansa Blg. 643, (1983-12-21) |publisher=Lawyerly |accessdate=February 25, 2021}} It finally became obsolete following the 1987 [[reapportionment]] that established two districts in the province under a new constitution.{{cite web|url=https://www.chanrobles.com/ordinance.htm |title=The 1987 Constitution of the Republic of the Philippines |publisher=Chan Robles Virtual Law Library |accessdate=February 25, 2021}} The district served as an electoral district in the [[Philippine Constitutional Convention of 1971|1971 Constitutional Convention]], with two delegates representing Agusan del Norte at-large.{{Cite PH act|url=https://elibrary.judiciary.gov.ph/thebookshelf/showdocs/2/14108|chamber=RA|number=6132|date=August 24, 1970|title=An Act Implementing Resolution of Both Houses Numbered Two as Amended by Resolution of Both Houses Numbered Four of the Congress of the Philippines Calling for a Constitutional Convention, Providing for Proportional Representation Therein and Other Details Relating to the Election of Delegates to and the Holding of the Constitutional Convention, Repealing for the Purpose Republic Act Four Thousand Nine Hundred Fourteen, and for Other Purposes}} The district was re-created in 2022 through a law that merged Agusan del Norte's two districts and made [[Butuan]] officially a [[Butuan's at-large congressional district|single legislative district]] separate from the province. The district was contested again in [[2025 Philippine House of Representatives elections|May 2025]].{{cite news|title=PRRD inks law creating lone district of Butuan|url=https://www.pna.gov.ph/articles/1173689|date=May 4, 2022|agency=Philippine News Agency |access-date=July 22, 2024}} == Recent election results from province-wide races == {| class="wikitable" !
